description: Declarative host-agent workflow; no automatic scheduler or tool transport.
required_outputs: Stable operation key and article ID
Verified state or precise pending/blocker state
stop_conditions: Dropped connection without an ID → inspect recent articles and calendar before retrying. An ambiguous match is a blocker, not permission to create another job.
Unknown integration/preset override → block creation. A brand-connected draft is not equivalent to no upload.
Queue still running at the bound → save ID and return pending. No completion-time promise and no background-monitoring claim.
